differences: Text A's copy may have new targets chosen ("You may choose new targets for the copy"); Text B gives the spell a cast trigger that copies it with no statement about choosing new targets.
Text A says a copy of a permanent spell becomes a token (reminder text); Text B says nothing about the copy being a token.
Text B grants the spell itself a delayed 'when you cast this spell' trigger rather than a one-time copy effect on the next spell cast this turn, so the copying mechanism differs.
